full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white pen illustration depicts an elaborate imaginary city viewed from above a busy roadway. The right half is dominated by an ornate stone building with tall pointed towers, turrets, arched windows, and sharply pitched dark roofs. Its high central tower rises beyond the top edge, while smaller spires step down toward the middle. A heavy stone bridge sweeps across the image from left to right at mid-height and joins the complex. Its broad central arch opens over the lower street, revealing a second layer of distant domes and buildings through the gap. The bridge parapet carries tiny figures and railings. At left, two tall-masted ships with dense rigging stand unexpectedly above or beside the elevated span, their thin black lines crossing the pale sky. Below, parallel tracks or narrow roadway lines lead from the bottom center through the arch into the far city. Small dark carriages and vehicles gather beside them, while many miniature pedestrians populate platforms, steps, and the street. The lower right wall is built from carefully drawn stone courses and small openings. The background sky is white with gray clouds made from loose curved hatch marks, and tiny dark birds scatter near the towers. The image is almost entirely ink line and wash: fine architectural details, rigging, crowds, and distant rooflines are picked out by tight strokes, while deep crosshatching strengthens the bridge underside and shadowed tower faces. Light appears diffuse from the pale sky, giving the stone facades bright open planes and leaving the arch interior much darker. The eye moves from the crowded foreground along the strong converging lines, passes beneath the bridge, and climbs the dense vertical towers. The composition feels immense and industrious because small animated details inhabit every level of the improbable architecture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白钢笔插画从繁忙道路上方描绘一座复杂的想象城市。右半幅由华丽石质建筑主导，有高尖塔、小塔楼、拱窗与坡度陡峭的深色屋顶。最高中央塔升出画面顶端，较小尖顶朝中部依次降低。一座厚重石桥在画面中高处从左向右扫过，与建筑群相连。中央宽拱在下方街道上方打开，从孔洞里还能看到远处第二层穹顶与建筑。桥栏杆上有微小人影与栏线。左侧两艘高桅船带着密集索具，出人意料地停在高架桥上方或旁边，细黑线横过浅色天空。下方，平行轨道或狭窄道路线从底部中央穿过拱洞，通往远城。小暗马车与车辆聚在两旁，许多微型行人分布在平台、台阶和街上。右下墙面由仔细描绘的石块行列与小开口构成。背景天空为白色，灰云以松散弯曲排线绘成，细小暗鸟散在塔楼附近。画面几乎全由墨线与水洗组成：细密建筑细节、索具、人群及远处屋顶用紧笔挑出，深交叉排线加强桥下腹和塔楼阴影面。光似乎从浅色天空漫射而来，使石立面保有明亮开放平面，让拱内明显更暗。视线从拥挤前景沿强烈汇聚的线条前进，穿过桥洞，再爬向浓密竖塔。微小而有动作的细节住满不可思议建筑的各个高度，因此构图显得巨大且忙碌。
style_prompt_en: Pen-and-ink illustration combines meticulous fine linework with loose gray washes and deep crosshatched shadow. Dense verticals, fine diagonals, and broad curving voids overlap in several spatial layers. Tiny repeated marks fill the lower zones, while larger high-contrast masses give the eye a clear framework. A pale paper ground opens behind dark sharp silhouettes; loose gray scumbles soften the upper negative space. Converging linear paths pull inward beneath a heavy transverse form, creating dramatic recession. Surface texture changes from precisely ruled edges to sketchier distant strokes, so the intricate field remains legible. Diffuse light keeps exposed planes bright and the undersides dark, producing an expansive, animated visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 钢笔墨线插画结合极细工整线条、松散灰色水洗与深交叉排线阴影。密集竖线、纤细斜线和宽阔弯曲空洞在几个空间层次里叠压。微小重复笔迹填满下部，大而高反差的形块为视线提供清楚框架。浅色纸底在深暗锐利剪影后打开；松散灰色揉擦柔化上部负空间。汇聚的线性路径从一块沉重横向形态下拉向内里，形成戏剧性后退。表面肌理从准确划出的近边转向较草绘的远处笔触，因此复杂色域仍可阅读。漫射光让露出平面发亮、下侧保暗，产生开阔而有动作的视觉节奏。
theme_en: A fantastical city of towers, bridge, ships, and crowded tracks
theme_zh: 一座由尖塔、桥梁、船与拥挤轨道组成的奇想城市
name: Albert Robida
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
